summary.text: Rebecca Bogden-Richards is the Democratic candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Eric Tilleman.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as nonprofit executive director.

paragraphs.text: Rebecca Bogden-Richards graduated from Cascade High School.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up on a working ranch in Cascade County, worked alongside her father in his business in Great Falls from an early age, and has worked with a national nonprofit and within city government in Great Falls.
Bogden-Richards advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
In the survey, she listed accessible health care, education, and responsible government as key messages, and named access to health care as the policy area she is most passionate about.
She listed Montana Families for Vaccines as an organization that endorsed her campaign.
